roadmap.title: Chapters 1 to 3
roadmap.description: Play the first three chapters, collect their hearts and the Chapter 1 cassette, find the PICO-8 computer in Chapter 3, and gather strawberries along the way.

roadmap.title: Chapters 4 to 6
roadmap.description: Finish Golden Ridge, Mirror Temple and Reflection with their hearts. Reach 80 strawberries and try the 1UP chain.

roadmap.title: The Summit and Core
roadmap.description: Climb The Summit, find its six gems for the heart, then finish Core.

roadmap.title: B-Sides 1 to 7
roadmap.description: Collect each chapter's cassette and clear the seven B-Sides.

roadmap.title: Core B-Side, C-Sides, Farewell
roadmap.description: Clear Core B-Side, all eight C-Sides, Farewell and the Moon Berry, and finish the remaining strawberries.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 7, The Summit, to climb Celeste Mountain.

steps.text: Play The Summit from the chapter select screen through to its end.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 1, Forsaken City.

steps.text: Play Forsaken City from the chapter select screen through to its end.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 2, Old Site.

steps.text: Play Old Site from the chapter select screen through to its end.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 3, Celestial Resort.

steps.text: Play Celestial Resort from the chapter select screen through to its end.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 4, Golden Ridge.

steps.text: Play Golden Ridge from the chapter select screen through to its end.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 5, Mirror Temple.

steps.text: Play Mirror Temple from the chapter select screen through to its end.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 6, Reflection.

steps.text: Play Reflection from the chapter select screen through to its end.

achievements.summary: Collect 30 red strawberries.

guide.context: Strawberries from any chapter count. Red strawberries are only in the A-Sides.

steps.text: Pick up strawberries as you play Chapters 1 to 3, which hold 63 together.

achievements.summary: Collect 80 red strawberries.

steps.text: Keep collecting through Chapters 4 and 5, which hold another 60.

achievements.summary: Collect all 175 red strawberries in the eight A-Sides.

guide.context: Berries per checkpoint: Chapter 1: 6, 9, 5. Chapter 2: 9, 8, 1. Chapter 3: 11, 7, 4, 3. Chapter 4: 8, 9, 7, 5. Chapter 5: 12, 11, 1, 6, 1. Chapter 6 has none. Chapter 7: 4, 6, 6, 8, 8, 8, 7. Chapter 8: 1, 3, 1. Winged strawberries fly off if you dash in their room. Seeded strawberries need every seed collected without touching the ground.

steps.text: Clear each A-Side checkpoint while checking its berry count against the list in the context.
Replay any chapter from chapter select for berries you missed.
Finish with the Core A-Side, which holds the last 5 berries.

achievements.summary: Collect one Cassette Tape.

guide.context: Every A-Side has one cassette, and it unlocks that chapter's B-Side.

steps.text: In @loc{Chasm} (Chapter 1), move the block aside and go to its far side, then go up to the room with the paths to strawberries 16 and 17.
Use the ground zipper to boost up. In the next room, move the zipper stuck to the wall out of the way and go behind it into the cassette room.
Jump across the blue and pink blocks, which switch on the beat, and touch the cassette.

achievements.summary: Collect six strawberries in one chain.

guide.context: Strawberries you pick up follow you until you land. Stay off the ground between pickups.

steps.text: Gather six strawberries in a row. Do not stay on the ground between pickups; jump again as soon as you land.
You can stand on moving blocks, such as traffic blocks, without cashing in the berries.
Land after the sixth berry to collect all six at once and unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Complete the PICO-8 version of Celeste.

guide.context: Celeste Classic has 31 screens. The chest at 2200 m holds a gem that gives two dashes in a row. It is optional but makes the game easier.

steps.text: In @loc{Huge Mess} (Chapter 3), find the computer in a secret area. Use the alternate way in, on the right-hand side of the big room.
Use the computer to unlock the PICO-8 game on the main menu.
Play Celeste Classic to the last screen, Summit, and touch the flag.

achievements.description: Collect the Crystal Heart in Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Collect the blue Crystal Heart in Chapter 1, Forsaken City.

steps.text: In @loc{Crossing}, reach the third room (two zippers: the first goes right into spikes, the second goes up). Ride the first zipper, jump onto the second and boost up-left to the sign with an up arrow.
Go left through the harder two-zipper room. Once you are outside the city, jump and dash left to the satellite.
Watch the computer screen. Its colors go white, purple, blue, red, purple, yellow. Each color matches a bird: white flies up, purple left, blue down-right, red up-right, yellow up-left.

Make six dashes, in this order: (1) up, (2) left, (3) down-right, (4) up-right, (5) left, (6) up-left. Nothing is timed. The heart appears after the last dash. The platform just left of the screen works best.

achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 1 B-Side, Forsaken City.

guide.context: The B-Side is unlocked by the cassette in the Chapter 1 A-Side, and it can be played before the A-Side is finished. It ends in a cassette block room with a red heart.

steps.text: If you do not have it yet, find the Chapter 1 cassette. In @loc{Chasm}, move the block aside, cross to its far side, go up and use the ground zipper to boost up. In the next room, move the wall zipper aside and enter the cassette room behind it.
Start the Chapter 1 B-Side from chapter select and play to the final cassette block room.
Dash into the red heart to end the B-Side.

achievements.description: Collect the Crystal Heart in Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Collect the blue Crystal Heart in Chapter 2, Old Site.

guide.context: The heart is right at the start of the chapter. You reach it by dashing through screen transitions, because each new screen refills your dash.

steps.text: From the first room (with the campfire), dash up-right into the screen change, then dash up-left right away. Grab the wall in the top-right corner and climb.
In the next room there is no platform. Climb up, then dash up when your stamina reaches zero (a neutral jump also works).
In the third room dash up-left. When you fall back into the second room, dash up again to re-enter the third room.
Grab the wall on the left of the third room and climb up to the heart.

achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 2 B-Side, Old Site.

guide.context: The B-Side is unlocked by the cassette in the Chapter 2 A-Side, and it can be played before the A-Side is finished. It ends in a cassette block room with a red heart.

steps.text: If you do not have it yet, find the Chapter 2 cassette. After the mirror shatters, return to the central room and dash down through the dream block in the floor at its bottom centre into the cassette room.
Start the Chapter 2 B-Side from chapter select and play to the final cassette block room.
Dash into the red heart to end the B-Side.

achievements.description: Collect the Crystal Heart in Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Collect the blue Crystal Heart in Chapter 3, Celestial Resort.

steps.text: In @loc{Huge Mess}, take the bottom exit among the two in the top-right corner. Press the big button that clears the towels.
Go right instead of left. Rise into the water stream nearby to open a secret path back to an earlier room.
Go up, then left, to the room where you met @npc{Theo}.
The exit at the top of that screen, once blocked by towels, is now open. Dash up through it and follow it to the heart.

achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 3 B-Side, Celestial Resort.

guide.context: The B-Side is unlocked by the cassette in the Chapter 3 A-Side, and it can be played before the A-Side is finished. It ends in a cassette block room with a red heart.

steps.text: If you do not have it yet, find the Chapter 3 cassette. In @loc{Elevator Shaft}, go to the seventh room, find the key, and take the hole in the wall just left of it, where light shines through.
Start the Chapter 3 B-Side from chapter select and play to the final cassette block room.
Dash into the red heart to end the B-Side.

achievements.description: Collect the Crystal Heart in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Collect the blue Crystal Heart in Chapter 4, Golden Ridge.

steps.text: In the @loc{Shrine} checkpoint, go past the hub room through the underwater passage to a hidden room with a strawberry.
Go one room further right and break the smashable wall. Climb the blocks; the heart is out of reach from here.
At the bottom of that room, stand on the white block and hold crouch for five seconds. Madeline sinks into the background.
Climb the background tiles up to the heart and dash into it.

achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 4 B-Side, Golden Ridge.

guide.context: The B-Side is unlocked by the cassette in the Chapter 4 A-Side, and it can be played before the A-Side is finished. It ends in a cassette block room with a red heart.

steps.text: If you do not have it yet, find the Chapter 4 cassette. In @loc{Start}, head to the upper-left corner of the tenth room, climb the clouds, return left and dash upward to a screen change. Keep going left, past the seeded strawberry, to the cassette room.
Start the Chapter 4 B-Side from chapter select and play to the final cassette block room.
Dash into the red heart to end the B-Side.

achievements.description: Collect the Crystal Heart in Chapter 5.
achievements.summary: Collect the blue Crystal Heart in Chapter 5, Mirror Temple.

steps.text: In @loc{Depths}, take the key above the statue, then enter the room under the statue on the right.

Ride the nearby bubble to the right. At its end, ignore the door and enter a second bubble heading left. On the way back, dash up into the centre of the second platform. A third bubble then lifts you to a hidden path over the door.
Walk the long hallway and cross the next room. In the room after it, dash down at the bottom to break the cracked floor block.
Use the key on the new locked door. In the heart room, follow the outer edges using the moving blocks and platforms to reach the heart.

achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 5 B-Side, Mirror Temple.

guide.context: The B-Side is unlocked by the cassette in the Chapter 5 A-Side, and it can be played before the A-Side is finished. It ends in a cassette block room with a red heart.

steps.text: If you do not have it yet, find the Chapter 5 cassette. In @loc{Depths}, past the third Temple Gate, go down and right to the hidden room with a red bubble. Ride it right and press the Dash Switch, then repeat through two more rooms and walk through the cracked wall at the bottom right of the third.
Start the Chapter 5 B-Side from chapter select and play to the final cassette block room.
Dash into the red heart to end the B-Side.

achievements.description: Collect the Crystal Heart in Chapter 6.
achievements.summary: Collect the blue Crystal Heart in Chapter 6, Reflection.

guide.context: The puzzle uses the same bird directions as the Chapter 1 heart. Torches can be lit in any order, with no time limit.

steps.text: In @loc{Hollows}, find the hidden feather close to the end of the first room. Fly straight up with it, then dash to catch the ledge.
Take the second feather and fly straight left, then dash to get into the puzzle room.
Torch 1, six dashes: (1) up, (2) left, (3) down-right, (4) up-right, (5) left, (6) up-left.

Torch 2: (1) up, (2) right, (3) down-left, (4) up-left, (5) right, (6) up-right. Torch 3: (1) down, (2) left, (3) up-right, (4) down-right, (5) left, (6) down-left. Torch 4: (1) down, (2) right, (3) up-left, (4) down-left, (5) right, (6) down-right.
Dash into the heart once it appears.

achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 6 B-Side, Reflection.

guide.context: The B-Side is unlocked by the cassette in the Chapter 6 A-Side, and it can be played before the A-Side is finished. It ends in a cassette block room with a red heart.

steps.text: If you do not have it yet, find the Chapter 6 cassette. At the start of @loc{Hollows}, near the heart, crash the Kevin Block into the wall at the far left to open the hidden room. The cassette is at its far left end.
Start the Chapter 6 B-Side from chapter select and play to the final cassette block room.
Dash into the red heart to end the B-Side.

achievements.description: Collect the Crystal Heart in Chapter 7.
achievements.summary: Collect the blue Crystal Heart in Chapter 7, The Summit.

guide.context: You need one gem from each of the first six subchapters. The heart is in a hidden room at @loc{3000 M}.

steps.text: Gem 1, @loc{Start}: in the final room, go all the way to the right before you board the last Badeline Booster for 500 M.
Gem 2, @loc{500 M}: in the third room go left. After strawberry 6, turn right. Close to the exit of the following room, drop through the small gap in the floor.

Gem 3, @loc{1000 M}: take the centre path past the fifth room and dash through the second dream block. Break the wall into the big room and press three touch switches, using the three moving dream blocks.
Gem 4, @loc{1500 M}: late in the seventh room, take the hidden path and dash through the moving dust bunnies, timing each dash.

Gem 5, @loc{2000 M}: in the second room go left to the big pit and dash straight up above the spikes to find a ledge to stand on. Dash left into the next room, pass under and around the stalactite, then go straight up to another ledge. Head left and up and leave through the top. Ride the move block to get out of the gem room.

Gem 6, @loc{2500 M}: ride the first Red Booster left, breaking the wall. Ride another Red Booster right through the walls and stay inside until it crashes. Go up into the long horizontal room and clear it.
At @loc{3000 M}, find the hidden room beside flag 28. A wall hides it, with a small gap under the wall. Take the heart inside.

achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 7 B-Side, The Summit.

guide.context: The B-Side is unlocked by the cassette in the Chapter 7 A-Side, and it can be played before the A-Side is finished. It ends in a cassette block room with a red heart.

steps.text: If you do not have it yet, find the Chapter 7 cassette. In @loc{1500 M}, find the opening in the ceiling of the fifth room; it leads to the cassette room.
Start the Chapter 7 B-Side from chapter select and play to the final cassette block room.
Dash into the red heart to end the B-Side.

achievements.description: Collect the Crystal Heart in Chapter 8.
achievements.summary: Collect the blue Crystal Heart at the end of Chapter 8, Core.

guide.context: Core A-Side has no separate chapter achievement. Its heart is the level's finish.

steps.text: Play Core from the chapter select screen to its last room and dash into the heart.

achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 8 B-Side, Core.

guide.context: Core B-Side starts with a Heart Door that needs 15 Crystal Hearts: all 8 blue hearts and the red hearts from the Chapter 1 to 7 B-Sides.

steps.text: Unlock it with the cassette at the end of Core A-Side, next to the heart.
Open the 15-heart door at the start of the B-Side.
Play to the final cassette block room and dash into the red heart.

achievements.summary: Complete all eight C-Sides.

guide.context: C-Sides unlock once Core B-Side is done. Each one is three or four long rooms with no checkpoints and ends in a yellow heart. Core C-Side starts with a 23-heart door.

steps.text: Finish Core B-Side to unlock the C-Sides.
Play each C-Side from chapter select to its end and dash into the yellow heart.
Before Core C-Side, own 23 hearts: the blue and red hearts plus the seven earlier yellow hearts.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 9, Farewell.

guide.context: Farewell opens after Core is finished. A Heart Door blocks more than half of the chapter and needs 15 Crystal Hearts: the 8 blue hearts plus the red hearts from the Chapter 1 to 7 B-Sides.

steps.text: Finish Core (Chapter 8) first, then pick @loc{Farewell} from the chapter select screen.
Own 15 hearts before you reach the Heart Door: the blue hearts from Chapters 1 to 8 and the red hearts from the B-Sides of Chapters 1 to 7.
Play Farewell through to its end.

achievements.summary: Collect the Moon Berry at the end of Farewell.

guide.context: The Moon Berry is in a secret route at the very end of Farewell, after the final generator.

steps.text: At the end of Farewell, break the final generator, then go left.
Jump off the floating blocks in the large room to reveal a secret path.
In the secret room, die to the spinners or retry so you respawn at the next section.
Cross the long jellyfish room to its end and collect the Moon Berry above the floating platforms.
